• Decorate – with stickers, GIFs or any image in your photo library
• Study – even cool people and weirdos have to study from time to time
• Video Chat – show your face (or hide it) while talking with friends
• Proximity Voice Chat – move around a space… the further away you are, the quieter you’ll be
• Message – send group chats or private DMs
• Create and Personalize – the entire Internet is your playground

Friendships can’t be organized in channels, and boring rectangles aren’t fun.  Make the perfect clubhouse for your friends… or build a world together that your friends can access from iOS or Desktop.  Here is weird, ridiculous and yours.  We hope you like it.
